owner_request.quote: a级别完美正样本起码要给我搞7-8000张啊  未必一定要在10000张里面选啊  再去拉点数据选出来
owner_request.interpretation: Expand the pre-holdout historical mother pool beyond the existing 10,000 examples, preserve the exact frozen Grade-A perfect gate, and build 8,000 clean model-input positive PNGs. Do not duplicate identical images or move variants of one event across time splits.

binance_um.provider: Binance official data.binance.vision USD-M monthly klines
binance_um.instrument_rule: Every USDT PERPETUAL in the saved exchangeInfo snapshot whose onboardDate is before 2026-05-01; TRADING and SETTLING are both retained because immutable pre-holdout archives remain valid.
binance_um.checksum: Every available ZIP must match its official sibling .CHECKSUM SHA-256.

grade_a_contract.definition: Exact PERFECT_CANDIDATE output of the hash-pinned perfect-filter preregistration: every hard gate, good-anchor combined and lock-step limits, accepted-family p95 limit, and minimum #42/#44 leave-one-out quality score remain unchanged.
grade_a_contract.future_visibility: Core+5 is used only to retrieve completed historical examples. These labels are not tip or forward signals.

deduplication.choice: Greedy by Grade-A quality; a candidate is kept only when it is more than four hours from every already-kept same-symbol/same-direction event, including another venue.

split.method: Global chronological cutoff over the widest render-plus-core+5 dependency interval; all variants of one event share the same split.
split.between_rules: excluded and not counted toward the 8,000 exposed images

output.window_bars: 18 for a 4-bar core and 19 for a 5-bar core
output.box_horizontal_distribution: Six fixed context pairs move the same 4/5-bar core across the image without shifting the semantic boundary.
output.training_images: clean renderer output; no red annotation pixels
output.labels: one YOLO box per image; class 0 LONG, class 1 SHORT
output.review_gallery: CSS red overlays over exact clean model inputs; no overlay PNG is substituted for a model input

capacity_probe.note: Read-only capacity probe; it did not write dataset artifacts and is not an evaluation score.
